SS41.name: 幽暗龙鱼
SS41.form: a sinuous ribbon-like body with faintly faceted scales, a narrow wedge-shaped head, a pair of swept-back horn-like crests, sparse luminous pores spaced evenly along the spine
SS41.fins: a low continuous dorsal crest of evenly spaced spines, a pair of long trailing pelvic tendrils
SS41.markings: a single row of evenly spaced luminous nodes along the flank, a faint chevron pattern behind the eye

SS42.name: 陨核鲽
SS42.form: an oval body with a subtly faceted surface, a compact head, a small terminal mouth, a dimpled crater-like pit set at the centre of each flank
SS42.fins: a short rounded dorsal fin, a small fan-shaped tail fin
SS42.markings: a cluster of evenly spaced luminous pores radiating from a central pit

SS43.name: 虚光鮟鱇
SS43.form: a rounded stout body, a broad flat head, a large gaping mouth, a single curved lure stalk rising from the snout, a row of slender recurved teeth
SS43.fins: a small rounded dorsal fin, a fan-shaped tail fin, fleshy limb-like pectoral fins
SS43.markings: a single luminous lure at the tip of the snout, a faint line of pores along the flank

SS44.name: 暗物质魟
SS44.form: a broad diamond-shaped disc with crisp bevelled wing edges, a blunt rounded snout, a long slender whip-like tail, a single small dorsal spine near the tail base
SS44.fins: wide angular pectoral wings with faintly faceted leading edges, a low fin fold along the tail
SS44.markings: a sparse arc of luminous pores tracing each wing edge, a single void-like ring centred on the disc

SS45.name: 星陨鳐
SS45.form: a broad diamond-shaped disc with faintly faceted wing panels, a short blunt snout, a long thin trailing tail
SS45.fins: angular pectoral wings with gently scalloped edges, a low fin fold along the tail
SS45.markings: a sparse scatter of luminous points across the wings, a faint streak trailing behind the disc

SS46.name: 虚空鲛
SS46.form: a torpedo-shaped body with faintly faceted flank plates, a long pointed snout, a row of slender recurved teeth, five gill slits
SS46.fins: a tall triangular dorsal fin, long swept-back pectoral fins
SS46.markings: a single row of evenly spaced luminous pores along the flank, faint void bands crossing the flank

SS47.name: 陨星鲟
SS47.form: a long spindle-shaped body with rows of angular scute plates, a conical snout, a small inferior mouth, four barbels before the mouth
SS47.fins: a dorsal fin set far back, a heterocercal tail fin
SS47.markings: five rows of faceted scutes running along the body, a sparse line of luminous pores along the flank

SS48.name: 星屑章鱼
SS48.form: a slender tapered mantle with faintly faceted panels, a rounded head with two large eyes, eight short arms and two long tentacles
SS48.fins: a pair of small triangular fins at the mantle tip
SS48.markings: a sparse scatter of luminous chromatophore dots across the mantle, a faint ringed pattern around each eye

SS49.name: 星陨旗鱼
SS49.form: an elongated torpedo-shaped body with crisp bevelled edges, a long pointed bill, a short blunt head
SS49.fins: a very tall sail-like first dorsal fin, a long slender pelvic fin, a crescent tail fin
SS49.markings: a row of faint vertical bars along the flank, a single line of luminous pores tracing the bill

SS50.name: 星核龙鱼
SS50.form: a sinuous serpentine body with faintly faceted scales, a tapered head, a pair of rearward-swept horns, a single luminous core node at the throat
SS50.fins: a low continuous dorsal crest of evenly spaced spines, a pair of long trailing whisker tendrils
SS50.markings: a row of evenly spaced luminous nodes along the spine, a halo ring behind the head
